items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And this is what John Pareles, part of what he said about you... [INTERVIEWEE] A great honor to that

ctx.x: And this is what John Pareles, part of what he said about you: “Mr. McBee makes the bass sing out clearly in every register and at any volume, even a whisper. He reaffirmed that only a handful of bassists can match his technique. He can also make virtually any tempo swing.” Nice. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

A great honor to that — wow. Like I just expressed, I’m one, you know, when having first arrived in New York, simply wants to express myself. I felt very privileged to play the instrument at whatever intent I had, because I had to realize the realization of the quality of my talent. It was just happening and I was happy to be on the stage and just play my butt off and have a good time. So that was a moment when that was happening. And if I remember that moment it was like I’m at Carnegie Hall, now I’m a little…
